hook: The woman and the man walk toward each other step by step on the sidewalk, the man keeps looking at his phone, city lights flicker, slow push-in.
eyes: The woman's eyes shift to the side, the glowing gaze lines follow her eyes, she blinks.
dance: Both step to the same side, then both step to the other side at the same time, awkward mirrored dodging dance.
nose: Both stand frozen face to face, blink, and then burst into an awkward laugh.
shuffle: The two pedestrians walk toward each other and zig-zag left and right along the glowing dotted paths, top-down view.
brainpath: The woman walks forward, the holographic trajectory lines extend ahead of her and a collision point blinks.
meter: The two walk closer, the glowing distance line shrinks and both begin to step aside.
gaze: The woman walks and keeps looking to her left, the glowing arrow on the ground pulses, the oncoming man notices and shifts.
read: The man glances at her eyes and smoothly steps aside, they pass each other easily.
phone: The woman walks slowly while scrolling on her glowing phone, people pass by around her.
crash: Both walk while staring at their phones and bump into each other, the coffee cup splashes, comic shocked reactions.
confident: The woman strides forward confidently and the crowd parts to the sides in front of her.
trick: The woman walks forward looking straight along the glowing teal path line, the oncoming person steps aside.
space: The woman walks through the parting crowd smiling, hair swinging, triumphant.
ask: The woman stops, turns to the camera and raises an eyebrow with a playful questioning grin.
follow: The woman smiles confidently and points at the viewer, the glowing rings pulse behind her, slight push-in.
